abilities.name: Rally the Line
abilities.text: When a friendly Disciplined squad figure within 4 hexes of Captain Vance defends, it rolls 1 extra defense die.

abilities.name: Call to Arms
abilities.text: Once a round, choose a friendly Disciplined squad with a figure within 4 hexes of Captain Vance. When her turn ends, that squad takes a turn straight away, without a token.

abilities.name: Massed Volley
abilities.text: Each Fusilier that is the third or later from its squad to attack the same target in a turn rolls 2 extra attack dice.

abilities.name: Answering Blade
abilities.text: When Lady Asagiri defends against an adjacent attacker and rolls more shields than it rolled skulls, the attacker takes 1 wound.

abilities.name: Circle Cut
abilities.text: Instead of a normal attack, Lady Asagiri may strike every enemy figure next to her, whichever way she faces, rolling her attack dice against each in turn.

abilities.name: Smoke Step
abilities.text: After a Shinobi attacks, it may move up to 2 hexes. It does not take passing strikes during this move.

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.text: Cinderjaw flies: count its move in hexes straight to where it lands, ignoring terrain, height and figures on the way. Terrain only affects it where it lands, and it never takes falling damage.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.text: Instead of attacking, Cinderjaw breathes fire along a straight row of 4 hexes from its own, in front of it. Roll 3 attack dice against every figure in the row, friend or foe; each defends normally. Terrain or scenery higher than Cinderjaw's head stops the flames.

abilities.name: Ember Scales
abilities.text: Cinderjaw rolls 1 extra defense die against attacks from 4 or more hexes away.

abilities.name: Hidden in the Leaves
abilities.text: A Warden standing on forest rolls 2 extra defense dice against attacks from 4 or more hexes away.

abilities.name: Deflector Field
abilities.text: Friendly figures adjacent to K-7 roll 1 extra defense die against attacks from 3 or more hexes away.

abilities.name: Twin Cannons
abilities.text: If K-7 has not moved this turn, it may make two normal attacks, at the same target or different ones.

abilities.name: Salvage Protocol
abilities.text: When a Reclaimer destroys an enemy figure, return one destroyed Reclaimer to the battlefield adjacent to the attacker.

abilities.name: Moss Armor
abilities.text: Old Rootback rolls 1 extra defense die against attacks from 4 or more hexes away.

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.text: Old Rootback may move through Small and Medium enemy figures. Each figure it moves through rolls 1 defense die; on a blank it takes 1 wound.

abilities.name: Shieldbearers
abilities.text: When a friendly hero next to a Pikeman takes wounds from an attack, a Pikeman next to that hero takes 1 of those wounds instead.

abilities.name: Field Dressing
abilities.text: At the end of her turn, Sister Maren removes 1 wound from herself or a friendly hero next to her, whichever is most wounded.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.text: Once a game, when wounds would destroy a friendly hero within 2 hexes of Sister Maren (or Maren herself), it is left with 1 Life instead.

abilities.name: Lantern Gaze
abilities.text: Instead of attacking, Kenzo may stare down an enemy Small or Medium figure that is not unique, up to 4 hexes away and in sight. Roll a d20: on 16 or more, that figure leaves its unit and joins your army as a unit of its own.

abilities.name: Mist Form
abilities.text: When Kenzo is attacked from 2 or more hexes away and rolls at least one shield, he takes no wounds from that attack.

abilities.name: Hurl
abilities.text: Instead of attacking, the Oni may grab an adjacent Small or Medium single-hex enemy and throw it onto a free hex up to 3 hexes away that the Oni can see. It takes 1 wound as it lands, plus any fall, and rolls for lava where it lands.

abilities.name: Oni Fury
abilities.text: While Ashfang Oni has at least 1 wound, it rolls 1 extra attack die.

abilities.name: Grove Song
abilities.text: Other friendly Elf figures within 3 hexes of Sylvanne roll 1 extra attack die.

abilities.name: Treewalk
abilities.text: Sylvanne may step from a forest hex to any other forest hex up to 8 hexes away, as one step costing 1 Move.

abilities.name: Mortar Barrage
abilities.text: Instead of a normal attack, Atlas may lob a shell at a figure 3 to 8 hexes away, even one out of sight, with 3 attack dice. Every other figure next to the target is also attacked with 1 die.

abilities.name: Quake Stomp
abilities.text: Instead of attacking, Atlas stamps: every other figure next to it, friend or foe, rolls 1 defense die. On a blank it takes 1 wound and cannot move on its unit's next turn.

abilities.name: Jet Packs
abilities.text: Raiders fly: count their move in hexes straight to where they land, ignoring terrain, height and figures on the way. Terrain only affects them where they land, and they never take falling damage.

abilities.name: Hit and Run
abilities.text: After a Raider attacks, it may move up to 2 hexes. It does not take passing strikes during this move.
